title: Logged claimed proofs of P vs NP, with where they broke
license_note: License: CC BY 4.0 covers only our additions (the one-line break-step summaries, labels and arrangement). The claims themselves belong to their authors. The list of claims comes mostly from Woeginger's page, which has no license line, so none of his text is copied.

rows.author: Ted Swart
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Yannakakis (STOC 1988; JCSS 1991) proved any symmetric LP for TSP/Hamiltonian cycle (as in Swart) needs exponential size, so the polynomial-size LP step fails.

rows.author: Tang Pushan
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Zhu Daming, Luan Junfeng, M.A. Shaohan refute the clique algorithm in "Hardness and methods to solve CLIQUE" (JCST 16, 2001). Woeginger does not state the exact step.

rows.author: N.C.A. da Costa; F.A. Doria
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Andreas Blass (MR2009291) says the consistency proof (Corollary 4.6) contains an error; Ralf Schindler also reviewed it.

rows.author: Hubert Chen; Craig Alan Feinstein
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Chen's piece is a joke argument; Feinstein's earlier "P is not equal to NP" paper was withdrawn after a counterexample was found (per Woeginger). Exact step not stated.

rows.author: Ki-Bong Nam; S.H. Wang; Yang Gon Kim
rows.label: NOT TRACED

rows.author: Moustapha Diaby
rows.label: GUESS
rows.where_it_broke: Reason: polynomial-size LP for TSP/SAT; Fiorini et al. 2012 proved TSP polytope needs exponential-size extended formulations, so the LP step likely fails (not checked against this paper).

rows.author: Craig Alan Feinstein
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Critique by Sabo, Schmitt, Silverman (June 2007) answers this proof; step not quoted here.

rows.author: Sergey Gubin
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Full refutation by Christopher, Huo, Jacobs (April 2008); Hofman also commented.

rows.author: Khadija Riaz and Malik Sikander Hayat Khiyal

rows.author: Jaeger
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Non-standard model of computation, unsupported assumptions, missing proofs.

rows.author: Javaid Aslam
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Ferraro, Hall, Wood "Refutation of Aslam's Proof that NP = P" points out a flaw; Aslam replied.

rows.author: Doron Zeilberger (1 April 2009, joke date)
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Definitions are ambiguous; every way to make them exact breaks the main proof.

rows.author: Vinay Deolalikar
rows.label: GUESS
rows.where_it_broke: Reason: widely reported issues in the FO(LFP)/solution-space step, discussed on Lipton's blog; not verified this run.

rows.author: Sergey Gubin
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Refutation by Romeo Rizzi (January 2011) per Woeginger; no link given on the page.

rows.author: Minseong Kim
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: The logic is inconsistent; under two reasonable readings of the definitions, P != NP does not follow.

rows.author: Frederic Gillet
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Author added to arXiv (Nov 2013): the proposed method does not work, paper to be withdrawn.

rows.author: Sopin
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: The paper fails to establish PH = PSPACE (problems listed in critique).

rows.author: Pawan Tamta; B.P. Pande; H.S. Dhami
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Refuted (with LaPlante) in "A Refutation of the Clique-Based P=NP Proofs of LaPlante and Tamta-Pande-Dhami".

rows.author: Michael LaPlante
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Refuted (with Tamta-Pande-Dhami) in "A Refutation of the Clique-Based P=NP Proofs of LaPlante and Tamta-Pande-Dhami".

rows.author: Alejandro Sanchez Guinea
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: The 3-SAT algorithm is flawed and does not show 3-SAT is in P.

rows.author: Daniel Uribe
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: The decision-tree lower bound does not cover all algorithms, and is flawed even where it applies.

rows.author: Manuel Blum
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Author withdrew it; arXiv now calls the original paper "incorrect" (replaced by another paper). The exact failing step is not stated there.

rows.author: Sima
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Fails where it claims to close the monotone vs non-monotone gap; a simple example shows the failure.

rows.author: Cho
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: A crucial step is not justified.

rows.author: Kumar
rows.label: SOURCED

rows.author: Czerwinski
rows.label: SOURCED

rows.author: Tianrong Lin
rows.label: SOURCED

rows.author: Yangjun Chen
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Multiple counterexamples; structures not properly defined; time analysis over-generalized.

rows.author: Lizhi Du
rows.label: SOURCED
rows.where_it_broke: Says an infinite family of satisfiable 3-CNF formulas is unsatisfiable.

rows.author: Deng
rows.label: SOURCED

rows.author: Quigley

rows.author: Tianrong Lin
rows.label: SOURCED
